product_family: AI-powered audio source separation and music processing tools. Core products: Isolate (vocal isolation), Denoise (noise removal), Batch (batch processing), Master (AI mastering).

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy acknowledges GDPR user rights: it states every user is 'entitled to' the right to access, rectification, erasure, restrict processing, object to processing, and data portability, and that 'If you make a request, we have one month to respond to you.' However, no formal GDPR certification audit or compliance attestation is claimed.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of HIPAA compliance. Service not designed for healthcare/PHI use.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification. Terms mention encrypted payment mechanism but do not specify PCI DSS compliance.

privacy.ai_training_note: Explicitly prohibited. Terms state: 'We WILL NOT use it for training or improving any artificial intelligence or machine learning models.' This is a strong privacy commitment differentiating AudioStrip from some competing services.
privacy.data_region: Not specified; uses PostHog (analytics processor) with pseudonymized IP and device information.

security.name: Payment Encryption
security.value: Uses encrypted secure payment mechanism; specific algorithm/standard not specified.

security.name: Bot Protection
security.value: Google reCAPTCHA for abuse protection on upload and account operations.

security.name: Analytics Processing
security.value: PostHog analyzes user behavior; IP addresses stored in pseudonymized/de-identified form, contractually prohibited from data resale.

security.name: Third-party Tracking
security.value: Google Analytics tracks user interactions; users may opt out. Google reCAPTCHA also present.

security.name: Data Processing Agreements
security.value: Not mentioned or offered; not verified to be available.

products.name: AudioStrip Isolate
products.data_scope: User-uploaded audio files (MP3, WAV, FLAC); outputs isolated vocals and instrumentals.
products.notes: Free tier: 3 isolations/month, 50MB limit, 8-min duration, 15-60 min processing. Premium: unlimited, 200MB, 20-min, 10x faster.

products.name: AudioStrip Denoise
products.data_scope: Speech/audio noise removal from user uploads.
products.notes: Included in free/premium tiers alongside Isolate.

products.name: AudioStrip Batch
products.data_scope: Batch upload and processing of multiple audio files.
products.notes: Premium feature only; enables processing of multiple songs in one operation.

products.name: AudioStrip Master
products.data_scope: AI-powered mastering service for audio files.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium subscription (free tier with limits; £5.99/month premium).
compare.data_residency: Not specified; cloud-hosted on unspecified infrastructure.
